description: This file defines the DefaultOAuthConfig class, which implements the OAuthConfig interface. It loads OAuth configuration settings from a Typesafe Config object, specifically handling the protocol and OpenID Connect issuer mappings, and provides accessor methods for these settings.

classes.name: DefaultOAuthConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing OAuth configuration, including protocol and issuer maps.

methods.name: loadIssuers
methods.description: Loads issuer data from config into a map of SubjectIssuer to String.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultOAuthConfig from a given Config object.
